exact_quote:
Saturation modifier:
.sat
limits result to MININT..MAXINT (no overflow) for the size and signedness of the operation. Applies only to .u32, .s32, .u16x2, .s16x2, .u8x4, .s8x4 types.
reason_for_inclusion: Notes rubric content: the .sat modifier applies to a separate saturating form (add.sat.u32) that also lists .u32 among applicable types; included as restriction context adjacent to the base add.u32 unit.
